general: The page continues a discussion of sections and actions, including an action on homology, a parenthetical note about the prime parameter, and formulations using sections and extensions. Several raised additions modify the prose near the bottom. This is an image-only reading. No mathematical claim has been verified or used to reconstruct missing ink. The preferred readings and alternatives reflect visual evidence, including unresolved subscript forms, a crossed-out phrase, and compressed words. Formula cases are represented with capital Pi where the ink has two straight cap-height uprights joined by a flat top bar.

A compressed r-shaped group followed by a raised t precedes the slash and angular capital K. rat is preferred, with rt retained because a distinct a body cannot be securely separated. No abbreviation point is visible. The slash is tall and curved.

The capital I has top and bottom serifs. The following tall stem is crossed rather than clearly looped, favoring Item over Idem. The small following letters are flattened; the whole word remains doubtful.

The H index has an angular rise and short foot, favoring 1, but an n-like reading is retained because it joins the right H stem and differs from the detached 1 in B007. The U subscript is barred eta, the separator is a comma, and the coefficient has T with a looped ell index. The whole formula is marked uncertain.
